title: Verify deterministic PDF artifacts and workflow
description: Verify parsed PDF structure, deterministic bytes and hashes, font treatment, visible generation refusal/success states, immutable audit persistence, and software-evidence disclosures through artifact and browser checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Parsed artifacts verify page count, explicit page boxes, text placement within renderer precision, and embedded/outlined required glyphs
Repeated identical normalized inputs produce byte-identical PDF bytes and identical hashes across fresh contexts
Missing resources, unsupported nodes, overflow, and renderer failures show named diagnostics with no partial success
Successful generation persists one immutable preparation containing reproducible inputs and matching output hash
Browser coverage verifies busy, refusal, success, download/open, and preparation-inspection states
Visible copy never claims physical scale, placement, printing, calibration, tolerance, or verification
Build, lint, unit/integration, artifact, and focused Playwright checks pass

steps.details: Define one valid text scene/page/resource fixture plus focused missing-font, missing-asset, unsupported-node, overflow, and renderer-failure fixtures with expected diagnostics.
Use an independent parser or inspection path to assert page boxes, page count, transformed text coordinates, font resources or outlines, and absence of uncontrolled private metadata.
Generate the canonical fixture repeatedly and in fresh contexts, compare complete byte arrays and final-byte hashes, then change one printable input and assert output changes.
Run every failure fixture and assert structured diagnostics, preserved draft, no downloadable bytes/object URL, and no new print preparation.
Navigate to Prepare PDF, inspect uncalibrated disclosures, generate, observe busy and success states, download/open, inspect the preparation, reload, and confirm immutable audit persistence.
Run build/type checking, lint, unit/integration and artifact tests, plus focused Playwright coverage; fix failures without replacing parsed-artifact assertions with snapshots alone.

technicalNotes: Artifact tests should inspect PDF semantics, not only file existence or a screenshot.
Passing software checks does not close the physical evidence gap recorded in TASK-1.
